newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Olympia stock to be suspended Monday.
newsitem.headline: Olympia stock to be suspended Monday.

text.p: Malaysian property company Olympia Industries Bhd requested that its shares be temporarily suspended from trade on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange from 9.30 a.m. on Monday, January 27.
The company said this in a letter to the exchange on Friday.
Olympia said the suspension was being requested pending an announcement.
No further details were given, and company officials could not be immediately contacted.
The stock had been requoted on Tuesday after an announcement that it had acquired an 88-acre plot of freehold land in Kuala Lumpur for 750 million ringgit.
Olympia stock closed on Friday at 2.45 ringgit.
